The Solution

03 — The Care Model
How Amaze Health Works
This isn't a telemedicine app with gig doctors. Amaze Health employs full-time, salaried medical providers who build ongoing relationships with patients across every specialty.
1. Reach Out
Message or call through the app. No phone trees, no intake forms, no waiting rooms.
2. See a Provider
Connected to a provider in under 30 seconds. They diagnose, treat, prescribe, and order labs.
3. Get Coordinated Care
Need a specialist? The care team coordinates referrals, follows up, and advocates on your behalf.
Full-Time Providers
Not contract or gig workers. Amaze Health doctors are salaried, W-2 employees who are invested in patient outcomes — not visit volume.
Care Coordination
One team manages everything — primary care, specialists, billing questions, prescriptions. Employees don't navigate the system alone.

03 — Real-World Scenarios
How Employees Use Amaze Health
9 PM Ear Infection
Employee's child has an ear infection after hours. Instead of an ER visit ($1,800+), they open the app, connect to a provider in 20 seconds, get diagnosed, and have a prescription sent to their pharmacy — all from the couch.
Saved: ER visit + time off work
Specialist Referral
Employee has persistent knee pain. The Amaze team evaluates them virtually, orders imaging, and coordinates a referral to an orthopedic specialist — handling the scheduling and follow-up so the employee doesn't have to.
Saved: weeks of scheduling + navigation
Confusing Medical Bill
Employee gets a $2,400 hospital bill they don't understand. The patient advocacy team reviews the charges, identifies billing errors, negotiates with the provider, and gets the bill reduced — at no extra cost to the employee.
Saved: stress + potentially thousands
Every scenario above is covered by the Amaze Health platform — included at no additional cost for enrolled employees and their families.

04 — Integrity Well-Being
The structure, simplified.
A voluntary Section 125 program that layers the full Amaze Health platform onto a fixed-indemnity policy. It complements existing major medical — no change to your carrier, network or plan design — and works for groups with no group medical at all.
01
Amaze Health
24/7/365 virtual primary, urgent and mental health care for the employee and their entire household. The clinical engine everything else is built on.
02
Pre-Tax Deduction
Premiums come out of each paycheck before taxes — just like existing health premiums. Taxable income drops for the employee and the employer.
03
Benefit Package
Accident and hospital indemnity, prescription savings, and biological screening — supplementing major medical, or standing on its own.
04
Claim Payment
Each participant receives a monthly claims payment that offsets their premium — often producing a net increase in take-home pay.

05 — The Employer Win
Employers save, too.
Because premiums are deducted pre-tax through Section 125, your FICA obligation drops 7.65% on every premium dollar, for every participating employee. Automatic each payroll cycle — no claims to file, no waiting period.

07 — Common Questions
What your CFO will ask.
How do we get employees to enroll?
Passive enrollment — the same model that took 401(k) participation from ~30% to over 80%. Employees are enrolled by default with a long, well-communicated runway to opt out before anything hits their paycheck.
What does it cost the company?
Net cost is negative. You pay a $40/employee/month administrative fee and save $114.75 in FICA on Plan 1500 — netting about $75 per enrolled employee per month. No premium contribution, no setup fees.
How much work is this for payroll?
One new pre-tax deduction code and your standard deduction file. We handle communications, enrollment, opt-outs, eligibility and employee questions. Most groups are operational in 30–45 days with no HRIS rebuild.
Does this replace our health plan?
No. It sits alongside it. No change to your carrier, network, plan design or renewal cycle. Employees who waive your medical plan can still participate — and the program works for groups with no group medical at all.
Is the structure legitimate?
It rests on three long-standing frameworks: Section 125 (in the code since 1978), HIPAA excepted benefits, and IRC §106/§105. You receive a plan document, SPD, ACA/ERISA notices, and the carrier's outside-counsel opinion letter.
Do employees do anything monthly?
Yes — about two minutes. The carrier needs a qualifying health interaction each month for the claim to issue: a telehealth visit, a short wellness check-in, or any covered service. Miss a month and there's simply no payment that month — no penalty, no clawback.

Your next step.
Once you sign the proposal, Nexus runs the rollout end-to-end — ending in passive enrollment, where positively-impacted employees are auto-enrolled with one-click opt-out.

Communication Plan

Weeks 2–7
Education & Enrollment

Go Live
First payroll deduction runs. We monitor the first cycles closely and stay on call for questions.
Ongoing, every pay cycle — automated payroll monitoring
Each pay run our software pulls your payroll report, recalculates every enrolled employee's tax position, and flags anyone whose situation changed. If someone is now negatively impacted we move them to another tier or disenroll them — communicated to your payroll team before payroll is finalized. You don't manage exceptions. We do.
